_about: Public-domain Robert Ainslie Redford, English minister and writer on Christian evidences, for the Word Hoard: The Christian's Plea against Modern Unbelief, Studies in the Book of Jonah, Four Centuries of Silence, Primer of Christian Evidence, and Vox Dei. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 132 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
